_comment: Hydraulic press digital-twin network. Extra _comment fields are documentation only; the C++ solver ignores unknown JSON fields.

fluid._comment: Fluid properties used for pipe friction, Reynolds number, Kv valve loss, and pressure/head conversion.
fluid.name: ISO_VG46_hydraulic_oil

design_basis._comment: High-level design assumptions. These values document the target machine and do not directly drive every calculation.
design_basis.pipe_material: E355+N / ST52 cold drawn seamless precision steel tube

solver._comment: Flow search bounds for bisection. The solver searches this L/min range for a flow where pump head and losses match the load pressure.

press._comment: The active mode load node receives this target pressure. downstroke/pressure_hold use N_CYL_CAP; upstroke uses N_CYL_ROD.

_comment_active_mode: Default mode for one-shot execution. Realtime CSV rows can override this using System.active_mode.
_comment_nodes: Nodes are hydraulic connection points. pressure_bar_g is gauge pressure; tank nodes are usually 0 bar(g).

nodes._comment: Tank suction reference node before the suction pipe. Usually fixed at 0 bar(g).
nodes.name: suction_1

nodes._comment: Pump inlet node. Negative gauge pressure here means suction vacuum relative to atmosphere.
nodes.name: suction_2

nodes._comment: Pump outlet node before the main pressure pipe.
nodes.name: pressure_1

nodes._comment: Directional valve P port. Relief valve also branches from this high-pressure point.
nodes.name: pressure_2

nodes._comment: Directional valve A port connected to the cylinder cap-side line.
nodes.name: a_pipe_1

nodes._comment: Cylinder cap-side chamber. This is the press load node during downstroke and pressure_hold.
nodes.name: a_pipe_2

nodes._comment: Directional valve B port connected to the cylinder rod-side line.
nodes.name: b_pipe_1

nodes._comment: Cylinder rod-side chamber. This is the press load node during upstroke.
nodes.name: b_pipe_2

nodes._comment: Tank return reference node for normal cylinder return flow.
nodes.name: return_2

nodes._comment: Reserved relief inlet node name; the current relief valve is connected from N_VALVE_P directly.
nodes.name: relief_valve_inlet

nodes._comment: Relief valve outlet before the relief return pipe.
nodes.name: relief_1

nodes._comment: Tank reference node for relief return flow.
nodes.name: relief_2

_comment_cells: Cells are hydraulic components between two nodes. Active mode paths select which cells carry flow.

cells._comment: Suction pipe from tank to pump inlet. Large diameter keeps suction vacuum and cavitation risk low.
Variable-speed pump. rpm can be supplied by realtime CSV; pump head follows the configured quadratic curve.

head_curve._comment: speed_ratio applies pump affinity law. Q is converted to equivalent rated-speed flow before the curve is evaluated.

cells._comment: Main pressure pipe from pump outlet to directional valve P port.
Directional valve metering path P -> A. Active in downstroke.
Directional valve metering path P -> B. Active in upstroke.
A-line pipe between valve A port and cylinder cap side. Reverse flow is allowed during upstroke return.
cells.material: E355+N / ST52 or high-pressure hydraulic hose

cells._comment: B-line pipe between valve B port and cylinder rod side. Reverse flow is allowed during downstroke return.
cells.material: E355+N / ST52 or high-pressure hydraulic hose

cells._comment: Directional valve return path B -> T. Active in downstroke.
Directional valve return path A -> T. Active in upstroke.
Normal return pipe from valve T port to tank return.
Relief valve branch from P port to tank. opening_percent controls effective Kv; set_pressure_bar_g is used for reporting.
Relief return pipe from relief valve outlet to tank.

_comment_modes: Modes define active flow paths. supply_path is solved from supply_start_node to load_node; return_path estimates backpressure.

downstroke._comment: Press down: pump flow goes to cylinder cap side; rod side returns to tank.
downstroke.description: P -> A, B -> T. Cylinder cap side is pressurized for press downstroke.

pressure_hold._comment: Closed-center hold approximation. No active flow path; target cap pressure is retained by code.
pressure_hold.description: Closed-center pressure hold. Cylinder cap side keeps the press target pressure with zero commanded flow.

upstroke._comment: Press up: pump flow goes to cylinder rod side; cap side returns to tank.
upstroke.description: P -> B, A -> T. Cylinder rod side is pressurized for press upstroke.

relief._comment: Overpressure discharge: pump/P-port flow goes through relief valve and relief return line to tank.
relief.description: Pump outlet/P port overpressure is discharged through relief valve to tank.
